name: 048.6 — widget:send, and the death of the target tokens
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 048.6: the escape hatch is widget:send(msg, ...) on the widget itself, protected and bound-widgets-only; hafen.act():raw is gone and its private target vocabulary ('mapview'/'gameui'/'root', a bare widget id) is deleted rather than rehoused, because every one of them is already an ordinary selector.
